The '''vestix tree''' was a [[Color/Legends|crimson]]-leafed [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. A huge vestix tree grew within a [[permacrete]] planter in the middle of the Promenade, [[Level 6]], [[Grid 10]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], situated between [[Gart's Frozen Fruit Snacks]] and the [[Grand Bespin Hotel/Legends|Grand Bespin Hotel]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
